g.title: Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Input into Server Interpreters I send POST /rest/user/login with email set to a target address followed by '-- and any password. C-03 · Authentication & Session Surface No account required Database access relies on concatenated queries (W-002) Unauthenticated login as any user including admin, plus UNION-based reading of the Users table with MD5 password hashes and TOTP secrets. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass or Forge Authentication I copy the RSA private key literal from lib/insecurity.ts:21 in the published repository. C-03 · Authentication & Session Surface No account required; Public source available Secrets are committed to source instead of a managed store (W-007) Anyone with repository access mints valid tokens for any user or role, giving full account takeover and admin access across every route guarded by isAuthorized(); this is the declared root credential of the token trust chain. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass Authorization to Gain Access I POST /api/Users with email, password, passwordRepeat and role set to admin. C-02 · Express REST API Server No account required No weakness linked in the register Unauthenticated creation of administrator accounts with full control over application data. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Access Exposed Data and Secrets A request-controlled path with `../` can read arbitrary files (/etc/passwd, source, secrets) or write outside the intended root. C-02 · Express REST API Server Regular account required Input handling lacks enforced boundary validation (W-004) Technical consequence not established. Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Stored eval executes server-side code I log in and POST /profile with a username wrapped in #{...} containing JavaScript. C-02 · Express REST API Server Regular account required Application data crosses into executable code (W-001) Server-side code execution with access to the SQLite database, password hashes, uploaded files and the application filesystem. Service disruption or compromise of application data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Scripts into Victim Browsers I craft a /#/search?q= link whose value is an HTML payload with a JavaScript handler. C-01 · Angular SPA Frontend No account required; Victim interaction required Frontend rendering lacks enforced output encoding (W-006) Script execution in the shop origin lets the attacker steal the victim's JWT session token (stored in localStorage) and act as the victim, including admins. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Abuse Cross-Site Requests An attacker hosts a page that auto-submits a form POST to /profile. updateUserProfile() authenticates solely by the token cookie at routes/updateUserProfile.ts:17, the cookie is set without SameSite at lib/insecurity.ts:192, and no CSRF token is checked, so a logged-in victim's username is changed by the attacker's page. C-02 · Express REST API Server Regular account required; Victim interaction required Cookie-authenticated changes lack request authenticity checks (W-011) Unauthorized modification of victim profile data; a crafted username is then evaluated on profile view (see eval finding). Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Supply-Chain / Build Attacker 1 role; access details in Identified Actors Compromise the Build or Its Inputs Publish a malicious patch release of a transitive dependency of juice-shop via a hijacked maintainer account. C-08 · CI/CD Pipeline Build or dependency access required Build pipeline trusts mutable third-party references (W-005) A poisoned dependency ships inside the published Docker image and release archives and executes in every downstream deployment, with no lockfile diff to reveal the change. Service disruption or compromise of application data
g.text: Compromise the Build or Its Inputs
